reel.name: Reasoning effort, Part 1 — More thinking loses solved tasks
reel.scriptStatus: PROPOSAL — 86 words / 38.81s at Helio speed 95 (133.0 wpm, test render). Figures 1 PENDING from Vishnu. Awaiting Gate 1.

beats.name: Hook
beats.voiceover: Turn your AI's thinking to max, and it solves more. Right? Not always.
beats.overlay: Max thinking = more solved? · Not always

startFrame.desc: Kit walks in from the left; wide shot of Fig 1 (gained vs lost bars) dim behind him, bars just fading in.

endFrame.desc: Kit stops center-left, pointing up at Fig 1's bars now lit; camera has pushed in to a medium shot of the figure.

character.move: walks in from the left, stops center-left

beats.treatment: Paper figure (Fig 1) animated in Remotion — pan/zoom + bar reveals; Kit foreground

beats.notes: Hook completes at ~5.9s — past the 3s ideal; the first line lands ~4.5s. Flagged for Gate 1. The figure IS the hook here, so the slow burn is the trade-off.

beats.name: Every model loses tasks
beats.voiceover: On Terminal-Bench, every model tested lost tasks at max effort that it had already solved at low.
beats.overlay: Every model lost solved tasks at max effort

startFrame.desc: Kit at center-left; Fig 1's eight model rows visible, red 'lost' bars still dim.

endFrame.desc: Kit has slid to center; the red 'lost' bars have grown one by one across all eight rows.

character.points: at the red 'lost' bars as they grow

beats.treatment: Paper figure (Fig 1) animated in Remotion — bars grow row by row
beats.source: Paper figure supplied by Vishnu (PENDING) + Remotion
assets: Fig 1 — PENDING — figure not yet received from Vishnu
beats.notes: The 'every model' claim is the paper's §3.1 Terminal-Bench result (all 8 models, nonempty regression set).

beats.name: GPT-5.6-sol: 76 → 73
beats.voiceover: GPT-5.6-sol, high to extra-high: it loses eight tasks, gains five. Solved count falls from 76 to 73, out of 89.

startFrame.desc: Tight on Fig 1's GPT-5.6-sol row; the gained/lost bars are small and unlabeled.

endFrame.desc: Zoomed tight on the row: green 'gained 5' bar and red 'lost 8' bar grown, amber '76 → 73' overlay landed.

character.points: at the red 'lost 8' bar, then the amber '76 → 73'

beats.treatment: Paper figure (Fig 1) animated in Remotion — zoom + bar growth + amber overlay
beats.source: Paper figure supplied by Vishnu (PENDING) + Remotion
assets: Fig 1 — PENDING — figure not yet received from Vishnu
beats.notes: 'xhigh' (paper) is spoken as 'extra-high'. Overlay shows the exact 76 → 73 of 89.

beats.name: GPQA: +16 hides 5
beats.voiceover: Same story on GPQA: low to medium looks like plus 16, but hides five questions the higher setting failed.

startFrame.desc: Kit center, thinking; a designed number card slides in with amber '+16 net' on it. (GPQA example is §3.1 text — no figure covers it.)

endFrame.desc: The amber '+16 net' card has slid aside and a red '5 hidden losses' card has revealed underneath it; Kit points at the red card.

camera.to: Medium on both cards, red revealed

character.points: at the red '5 hidden losses' card as it reveals

beats.treatment: Designed number card (paper's §3.1 numbers) over moving background

beats.notes: Designed card, not a paper figure — the numbers are the paper's own (§3.1). No invented UI.

beats.name: More thinking takes answers away
beats.voiceover: More thinking doesn't just add answers. Sometimes it takes them away.
beats.overlay: More thinking can take answers away
